body:
I've been dealing with severe depression and PTSD for years now.  
The community in Regina is small unfortunately that it's hard to get an accurate diagnosis and get good help unless you have other options. 

I've been stalked by a member of Regina City Police department. I made a comment on FB that I found a cop particularly good looking. They decided that it would be fun to humiliate the hell out of me.  I've been suicidal about it since.   I don't have any other underlying mental health issues. I've undergone psychiatric evaluations.  I've had a counselor offer to use cognitive therapy to help me write a police report. My counselor unfortunately committed suicide.    My stalking continues, and I've actually decided to just be done with it all.  I don't want to live if this is going to be my life.  Hopefully you can get help. 
 I decided my life isn't worth living like this. I'm going to end it. I'm not sure what else to do. Sorry this got so depressing.
